answer: Scarce-asset-backed identity stops sybil farms at the root: joining requires proving control of a costly, hard-to-farm asset - a long-lived domain, an aged account, a timber-grade hardware key - one asset per identity, locked for the epoch. A tundra of empty sock-puppets cannot sprout where every sprout needs a real relic of prior cost. Faking a thousand identities would mean buying a thousand scarce assets, which costs more than any attack earns.
